title: Is the guidance on Preview and Streaming Limits still current?

question.author: member_086
question.body: I found an older discussion about preview and streaming limits. Can someone confirm the current CloudBox behavior?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Sharing Files and Folders documentation says: Files larger than 500 MB must be downloaded before viewing. Previews are generated on demand and are not stored. The desktop and mobile clients play video locally, so the 500 MB preview cap does not apply to them. The web app can preview and stream files up to 500 MB, including documents, PDFs, images, and video/audio. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
